name: Sonoya Chika
source:
Misaki’s class mate.

She is good with dealing with people and has a pure personality.

She often laughs and talk and like interesting things.

She talks respectfully to the teachers and those above her while not forgetting to maintain her “senpai” image. She also has diligent side to her personality.

She is friendly with Sayaka since the later enrolled into the school.
They are always together even in class, and are considered a good “combination” by those around them.

She loves dogs and despite not being able to keep one at home, she secretly takes care of an abandoned dog that is near the dormitory.

She is innocent when it comes to love, among the members she is the most “pure-hearted” maiden.
